description: Erection of a two storey side infill extension, replacement of the garage door with a roller shutter, the installation of two air conditioning units on the existing side elevation, and internal alterations
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
